parsed.summary: Tracing every interface in the drawing matches the specification: D1 (SS54) between J7 and +5V, D2 (PMEG3030EP) feeding the servo rail that connects to J3/J8 pin 2 with C1-C4 (100u) bulk caps, R3/R4 (1k) from PWM1/PWM2 to J3/J8 pin 3, R13/R14 (0) bridging those pins onto the MAX3485 TTL net, R9-R12 (0) selecting PWM1_C1/C2 and PWM2_C1/C2, the Q1/SW1/R5 battery path, the Q2/R1/R2/R7 auto-direction network, and the MAX3485 with DE/RE (pins 1-2) driven from the Q2 collector, DI (pin 3) on TXD2 and RO (pin 4) on RXD2, A/B tied to TTL with the R6/R8/R15 bias network and C5 decoupling. All reference designators, part names, values and the literal schematic annotations ('Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3 / Short R9, R11 for others', 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo', 'forward voltage > 0.6V', '3A 360mV') agree with the spec, and the documented 'R10, R10' typo and inferred items are reference-design properties, not deviations. No deviation from the intended design is supported by the drawing.
